asked.item: Scheduling for a specific time despite the 'No available slot time found' message

verdict.reason: The help sentences explain what slots are and say to use Pick a time for an exact time without a recurring slot.

steps.text: Slots are recurring posting times that you set up using local time, weekdays, and eligible accounts.
A recurring slot is a timing rule, not a scheduled post, and a weekly slot provides a time for posts submitted with Next free slot time.
The message 'No available slot time found' applies when Next free slot time reports no available time in the next 9 months.
To schedule at an exact time, use Pick a time, because slots are not required for it.
